summary: Code Quality Analysis fixes testing completed. Backend: 24/24 tests passed (100%). Frontend: Unable to test via Playwright due to Emergent platform loading overlay blocking access. action_items: Frontend testing blocked by Emergent platform loading overlay - may need to wait for platform to fully initialize or check platform configuration
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.jsx: Secure storage properly implemented - tokens in sessionStorage with expiration, user profile in localStorage. clearAuth() removes from both storages plus legacy cleanup.
apiClient.js: Secure storage duplicated correctly with legacy token migration support. Token expiration check implemented.
biometricAuth.js: Uses localStorage for biometric credentials (appropriate since they're device-bound references, not sensitive data). 90-day expiration added.
pushNotifications.js: Uses localStorage for notification settings (appropriate for non-sensitive user preferences). Key prefixes updated to 'pursible_'.
WithdrawNGN.jsx: Hook dependencies fixed - useEffect includes [bankAccounts, selectedBankId, setSelectedBankId].
WalletOverview.jsx: Hook dependencies fixed - useEffect for balance announcement includes [totalInPrimary, primaryCurrency, announceBalance, prevTotalInPrimary].
RateAlerts.jsx: Hook dependencies fixed using useRef pattern - checkAlertsRef stores latest callback, interval uses ref to avoid stale closures.
Transactions.jsx: Hook dependencies fixed - useEffect for page reset includes [typeFilter, statusFilter, directionFilter, search, setPage].
DocUpload.jsx: Nested ternaries refactored into separate render functions (renderUploadedState, renderUploadingState, renderErrorState, renderIdleState) with renderContent() dispatcher.

server.py: Type hints added to utility functions - generate_id() -> str, get_timestamp() -> str, hash_password(password: str) -> str, verify_password(password: str, hashed: str) -> bool, create_jwt_token(user_id: str, email: str) -> str, decode_jwt_token(token: str) -> Dict[str, Any], log_error() with Optional types.
seed_data_creation: Test user created via registration API
